author: Simon's Cat
description:
Back in 2019, Simon's Cat went missing after an unpleasant bath time experience! How did he find his way back home?! Find out in this full colour special, 'Missing Cat,' now in 4k!

Every Friday, we’re releasing a classic film remastered in 4K and colour. At the end of each month, you can also watch a full compilation of that month’s episodes — ideal for the big screen! 🍿
